title: Ohio Goofy Ahh
blurb: At some point around 2022 the internet decided Ohio was a cursed dimension where physics no longer applies, and nobody involved could explain why Ohio specifically. This clip is what that dimension sounds like: chaotic, distorted, and funny for reasons that resist analysis entirely. The only in Ohio format worked because it needed no setup — any inexplicable footage plus those three words produced a complete joke. Play it over anything that should not be happening and the caption writes itself. Ohio remains, by every available measure, undefeated.
origin: From the 'only in Ohio' meme era — Ohio as the internet's cursed dimension.
